UnitStatement: The DEL-17-08 export is not a solver model, not an analysis result, not a compatibility claim, and not professional acceptance evidence.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: A visible pipe-like shape does not prove that wall properties, support behavior, branch flexibility, load cases, stress recovery, rule-pack inputs, or target-solver interpretation are complete.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: When the exporter emits simplified geometry it shall be described as review geometry.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: The review artifact is only useful to OpenPipeStress workflows if visible objects can be traced back to the canonical model.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Prefer stable canonical IDs over display-order assumptions; use direct metadata only where the profile says it is reliable enough, otherwise pair the geometry with a sidecar ID map referenced from the manifest.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: For E-002, 'reliable enough' means the future profile has source-grounded consumer-risk criteria for the selected metadata location, including whether the receiving workflow may ignore, alter, or strip the metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Until the profile threshold exists, direct metadata remains a candidate and sidecar mapping remains the auditable fallback.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Do not rely on glTF indices or generated names as the only identity layer unless the loss report records the limitation and the profile accepts it for the selected use.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: The profile should state what is emitted and what is not, especially for supports, restraints, components, equipment interfaces, and annotations where a visual marker may communicate less than the source model knows.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Unresolved behavior remains TBD and should not be softened into phrases such as 'supported by default' or 'compatible with viewers' unless a later source-grounded profile and test set support that wording.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: GLB/glTF metadata and sidecars can accidentally expose private project names, owner criteria, component tags, rule-pack notes, or proprietary catalog data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: The review-geometry profile should distinguish user-private metadata from public fixture metadata and should default public examples to invented or rights-cleared data only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Coordinate policy: glTF uses a right-handed +Y-up basis and meters; source model axes, project vertical axis, origin, scale, and transform recording remain profile decisions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Geometry level of detail: first coverage may be centerline-only, simplified tube/symbol geometry, or another declared subset; the choice remains TBD and should be loss-report driven.
Metadata placement: glTF extras and object name fields are candidate places for direct review metadata; a sidecar remains necessary when metadata needs stronger auditability or may be stripped.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Extensions: avoid required custom extensions unless the profile records viewer impact and fallback behavior; extensions used by an asset must be declared per glTF 2.0.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Hashing: GLB is binary, so the manifest should hash the emitted binary when deterministic or record why a hash cannot be stable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Fixtures: public fixtures must be invented or rights-cleared and should avoid real project/client/tag data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Viewer behavior: viewer-specific rendering, selection, metadata display, and stripping behavior remain TBD; do not claim viewer compatibility in Phase A.
For E-001, viewer-specific behavior is evidence-dependent wording; a later profile may name viewer behavior only after source-grounded or test-recorded evidence exists.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Centerline-only line primitives are simple, compact, and easy to correlate with line/element IDs but may be mistaken for incomplete physical geometry; acceptable candidate only with a clear loss report.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Simplified tube/surface primitives are more visually inspectable but require more geometry generation and may imply false dimensional fidelity; must be labeled review geometry.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Direct extras metadata keeps identity near the visible object but some tools may ignore or strip it and the schema remains target-specific; it is a candidate, not final policy.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: A sidecar ID map gives a stronger audit trail and stable identity contract but requires consumers to keep files together; it is a required fallback and likely package member.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: A required custom extension can structure metadata explicitly but reduces viewer portability and requires extension governance; defer unless a later profile justifies it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: For D-002, a later profile should choose the first review-geometry level of detail by asking whether the representation supports visual orientation, canonical-ID correlation, and limitation disclosure without implying solver, CAD, fabrication, or analysis fidelity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: Centerline, simplified tube/surface, symbol, annotation, and overlay choices should be justified by coverage, identity, viewer-risk, package size, deterministic generation, and loss-report clarity; unchosen or unresolved families remain TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-001: PKG-17 deliverable -> CAT-018.

UnitStatement: No example model, GLB file, glTF JSON snippet, proprietary fixture, commercial target file, or standards-derived engineering example is included in Phase A.
